6 of 8 tile data-testids do not match the spec. Spec requires loc-1142, loc-2218, loc-3304, loc-4490, loc-5576, loc-6652, loc-7738, loc-8865. Implementation renders loc-1142 and loc-8865 but uses loc-2207/3054/4411/5019/6122/7731 for the middle 6. Either spec or store-id list needs reconciliation.

React hydration warning — '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Some emergent x-id/x-dynamic wrappers are injecting <span style={display:contents}> inside <option> children. Cosmetic but pollutes the console.
